subject: Next steps & constraints — MedSecure private deployment discovery
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference>
To: Susan Lee <susan.lee@medsecure.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 15:02:00 +0100
Subject: Next steps & constraints — MedSecure private deployment discovery

Hi Susan — thanks again for the productive call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single shared record.

Summary of the problem/goal
- Primary driver: EU data residency + regulator requirement for isolation (no cross-border processing).
- Preferred hosting: customer-controlled VPC or fully on-prem (air-gap where required).
- Non-negotiable: audit logs, SMB/SOC2 evidence, and ability to retain keys (BYOK).

Technical constraints you called out
- No direct outbound internet from inference nodes; any egress must be via approved proxy/gateway.
- NetOps requires a list of inbound/outbound ports and an ASN for peering.
- Expected steady-state throughput ~40–60 requests/sec with occasional spikes up to ~120 RPS during daytime windows.
- Latency target for inference path: median under 200ms for 512-token requests.

What Redwood can do (short)
- Offer a Private deployment (VPC-hosted) with strict egress controls and optional dedicated appliance for proxying to approved storage.
- Support KMS/HSM integration and BYOK workflows (we’ll provide details and audit evidence).
- Propose a 6-week on-prem pilot (sizing below) before full rollout.

Asks / action items
1) Please share current NetOps contact and a basic network diagram (public/private subnets, proxies, firewalls).
2) Confirm whether an air-gapped pilot is mandatory or if a locked-down VPC is acceptable for initial POC.
3) Procurement target date / constraints for Q4 decisioning.
4) Any internal compliance forms (questionnaires) we should complete ahead of the workshop.

Attachments: redwood_vpc_requirements_v1.pdf (requirements checklist), mutual_action_plan_draft.xlsx (draft timeline / roles)

If this looks right I’ll loop in our infra lead (Marissa) and propose a 60–90 minute joint workshop to walk NetOps and Security through the design and evidence.

Thanks,
Jonas

From: Susan Lee <susan.lee@medsecure.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:12:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Next steps & constraints — MedSecure private deployment discovery

Jonas — really helpful summary, thanks. A few clarifications from our side:  

1) Air-gap vs VPC: our security steering group prefers an air-gapped option for PHI workloads. That said, we may accept a locked-down VPC for an initial pilot if we can demonstrate the same controls (no egress, certified KMS). For production we expect isolated on-prem or a fully air-gapped deployment.

2) NetOps contact: Alex Dupont (alex.dupont@medsecure.com) — he will own the network diagram and port approvals. I’ve cc’d him on this thread for visibility.

3) KMS/BYOK: we require a pattern where keys are generated and controlled by MedSecure HSM. Can you confirm Redwood supports external HSM integration or a BYOK flow with no key material persisted by Redwood?

4) Sizing question: for the pilot we are likely to provision a minimal GPU footprint (we’re evaluating A10 vs A100). Can you return a short note on recommended starter size and estimated rack footprint?

Procurement timeline: aiming for a decision by end of October; legal will need a first pass by mid-October.

I’ll follow-up with Alex on our NetOps availability for the workshop.

Best,
Susan Lee
Head of Platform Security | MedSecure
susan.lee@medsecure.com

Susan / Alex — quick answers inline and a proposal for next steps.

KMS / BYOK
- Redwood supports customer-managed keys via standard KMS APIs and can integrate with customer HSMs using an HSM-backed KMS gateway. We do not persist key material in plaintext; keys can be generated and wrapped by your HSM. I’ll attach our short whitepaper on BYOK and the SOC2 evidence checklist.

On-prem pilot sizing (starter recommendation)
- Small pilot: 1x A100 80GB (recommended) or 2x A10 (cost-conscious alternative) — handles ~50 RPS at 512-token median with 150–220ms median latency depending on model choice and quantization.
- Rack footprint: 1U–2U per node depending on vendor; initial pilot can be accommodated in a single server chassis.

Network / egress pattern
- We can operate with zero direct egress from inference nodes. Approved egress can be proxied to an approved S3 endpoint or on-prem object store; we’ll provide a short list of required ports (TCP 443, SSH for maintenance via jumpbox if allowed, and specific ephemeral ports for internal orchestration).

Proposed next steps / workshop
- 60–90 minute joint workshop with NetOps, Security, and Infra to validate network diagram, egress controls, and HSM integration.  Draft agenda:
  * Introductions & goals (10m)
  * Network diagram walk (20m)
  * KMS/HSM integration patterns & evidence (20m)
  * Pilot sizing & ops model (15m)
  * Action items & timeline (15m)

Availability: we can host the workshop week of 2026-09-20 or 2026-09-27. Please confirm a preferred slot and I’ll have Marissa lock it in and share a shared doc.

Attachment: onprem_pilot_sizing.pdf (starter sizing & rack guidance)

Thanks — Jonas
